svg.title: SBMS code history
svg.desc: Mainline source-code changes, 2026-06-27 to 2026-11-11. Each commit adds green upward candles then red downward candles. Linear cumulative net lines; equal spacing per commit. Excludes vendor code, non-code files, this chart generator and chart-only commits. Snapshot 121d3f3a16765065a9a6758acc0e2648959d1dba.
